Health check timed out（但服務其實是好的）: Health check timed out (but the service is actually fine)
<b>症狀</b> 更新流程最後一步逾時，可是用瀏覽器打得開。: Symptom　The last step of the upgrade times out, yet the site opens in a browser.
<b>原因</b> 改過監聽位址或連接埠（<code>jtdt bind</co: Cause　After changing the listen address or port (jtdt bind), older versions read the address from the environment of the shell running the upgrade — where it was never set — so they always probed 127.0.0.1:8765. A corporate http_proxy can also send "connect to myself" through the proxy.
<b>怎麼辦</b> v1.15.15 起已修（改讀服務管理員自己的設定、直連不: What to do　Fixed in v1.15.15 (it reads the service manager's own configuration, connects directly, and prints which addresses it probed plus the last 20 log lines). Upgrade to at least that version; if it still times out, read the end of jtdt logs.
<b>症狀</b> 更新、下載 OCR 語言檔、或連 LLM / SSO 時憑證: Symptom　Certificate verification fails during an upgrade, while downloading OCR language files, or when connecting to an LLM / SSO.
<b>原因</b> 公司的 TLS 檢查代理把外部憑證換成自家 CA，而 Pyt: Cause　A corporate TLS-inspection proxy replaces external certificates with its own CA, which Python and uv do not trust by default.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 程式會自動接上作業系統的信任庫（<code>trustst: What to do　The program hooks into the operating system's trust store automatically (truststore), so most environments need no configuration. If it still fails, import the corporate CA into the OS trust store; JTDT_TLS_INSECURE=1 bypasses verification temporarily (only on a network you trust).
<b>症狀</b> <code>jtdt update</code> 說找不到: Symptom　jtdt update says git is missing, or that this is not a git repository.
<b>原因</b> 機器上沒有 git 時，一行安裝會改走下載壓縮檔那條路，\n: Cause　Without git on the machine, the one-line installer falls back to downloading an archive, so the installation has no .git.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 裝上 git 之後重跑一次一行安裝指令 —— 它會<b>原: What to do　Install git and run the one-line installer again — it adopts the existing directory into a git repository (your .venv and data are kept), after which updates work normally.
Windows 找不到 git，或說要用 winget 安裝: Windows cannot find git, or asks you to install it with winget
<b>症狀</b> 剛裝完 git 還是找不到；或 Windows Server: Symptom　git was just installed but still cannot be found; or Windows Server has no winget.
<b>原因</b> 剛安裝的程式只更新登錄檔裡的 PATH，<b>已經開著的終端: Cause　A freshly installed program only updates PATH in the registry — terminals that are already open (including new tabs) still see the old one; and Windows Server 2019 / 2022 ship without winget.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 直接再跑一次即可，<b>不必重開機</b> —— 程式會依: What to do　Simply run it again — no reboot needed: the program looks in PATH, then the registry, then the standard install locations. On Server editions, download the installer from the git website.
<b>症狀</b> 用安裝程式裝到既有安裝上時失敗；無介面安裝還會像卡住不動。: Symptom　Installing over an existing installation fails; a silent install appears to hang.
<b>原因</b> 服務還跑著，<code>python.exe</code>: Cause　The service is still running and python.exe holds the virtual environment's files open, so they cannot be deleted. Older failure dialogs had no silent-mode default, so they waited for a button nobody could press.
<b>怎麼辦</b> v1.15.37 起已修（安裝前先停服務並等行程真的放掉檔: What to do　Fixed in v1.15.37 (the service is stopped and its handles released before anything is deleted, and every dialog has a silent default). If it hangs, stop the service manually first; the installer's own log is at C:\ProgramData\jt-doc-tools\Logs\installer.log.
升級時磁碟空間不足: Not enough disk space during an upgrade
<b>症狀</b> 備份階段失敗，而且服務已經停掉了。: Symptom　The backup step fails — and the service has already been stopped.
<b>原因</b> 升級前會完整備份資料目錄並保留三份。: Cause　Upgrades take a full backup of the data directory and keep three of them.
<b>怎麼辦</b> v1.15.17 起<b>在停服務之前</b>就先檢查空間: What to do　From v1.15.17 the space is checked before the service stops, and the message says how much is missing; the backup also skips anything that rebuilds itself (the company-ID database, temporary files, job results) — measured 1.93 → 0.56 GB per backup. Free up space and run it again.
<b>症狀</b> 用 <code>sudo</code> 跑過某個 CLI 指: Symptom　After running a CLI command with sudo, the service can no longer write to the database.
<b>原因</b> 以 root 執行時新建出來的檔案屬於 root，而服務是用: Cause　Files created while running as root belong to root, while the service runs under its own account. The easiest one to hit is jtdt reset-password — the rescue command locks you out.
<b>怎麼辦</b> v1.15.16 起所有 CLI 指令結束時都會把資料目錄: What to do　From v1.15.16 every CLI command restores ownership of the data directory when it finishes. On older versions, fix the ownership by hand (Linux: sudo chown -R jtdt:jtdt <data directory>).

遠端使用者一上傳就「CSRF token 遺失或不正確」: Remote users get "CSRF token missing or incorrect" as soon as they upload
<b>症狀</b> 在伺服器本機怎麼測都正常，只有從別台電腦連進來會失敗；\n: Symptom　Everything works when tested on the server itself; only connections from another machine fail. Sign-in may also bounce back to the login page.
<b>原因</b> 反向代理把 <code>X-Forwarded-Proto<: Cause　The reverse proxy sets X-Forwarded-Proto to a fixed https while the site is actually http — so the backend marks cookies Secure and the browser drops them over plain http. http://localhost is a secure-origin exception, which is why it cannot be reproduced on the server itself.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 讓反向代理照實傳協定（IIS 用 <code>rewrit: What to do　Make the reverse proxy pass the real protocol (on IIS, use a rewriteMap to translate {HTTPS} into https/http), or serve the site over HTTPS. Examples are in OPS.md.

<b>症狀</b> 語音服務設定頁按「測試連線」失敗；辨識模式的下拉顯示\n: Symptom　“Test the connection” fails on the speech service settings page; the recognition profile dropdown shows “Could not read the list: Cannot reach the speech service”; or submitting a recording fails.
<b>原因</b> 送件位址填錯（主機、埠、<code>http</code>: Cause　The endpoint is wrong (host, port, http or https), a firewall is in the way, or their service is down. It can also be certificate verification: when they use a self-signed certificate, the connection is refused at the TLS step, and the screen still only says it cannot reach them.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 送件位址照對方給的整串貼（例：<code>https://: What to do　Paste the endpoint exactly as they gave it (for example https://host:8790/api/v1). On the machine running this system, try curl https://host:8790/api/v1/health: if it cannot connect, the problem is the network or the address; if it only connects with -k, the problem is the certificate. Paste their certificate (PEM) into “Their certificate”, and save only after checking it against the SHA-256 fingerprint they publish. Do not work around it by turning verification off: every submission hands over the API key, and with verification off anyone can impersonate them.
「jtlw 不接受這把金鑰（401 / 403）」: “The speech service rejected this API key (401 / 403)”
<b>症狀</b> 「測試連線」或送件時出現這句話。: Symptom　This message appears when testing the connection or submitting.
<b>原因</b> 金鑰打錯、被對方撤銷，或貼成了整條標頭。只測對方的健康檢查是: Cause　The key is mistyped, was revoked on their side, or was pasted as a whole header. Their health check cannot reveal this because it does not check the key; that is why “Test the connection” also asks once with the key.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 「API 金鑰」只貼金鑰本身（對方給的那一串）；\n: What to do　Put only the key itself in “API key” (the string they gave you); this system builds the Authorization: Bearer header itself (a pasted prefix is removed automatically). If it is still 401 / 403 after checking, ask them to confirm the key is still valid.
「對方不接受我們這台的位址 —— 請管理員把『錄音檔對外位址』給對方加進允許清單: “The speech service does not accept this machine's address. Ask your administrator to add the public address for recordings to its allow list.”
<b>症狀</b> 送出錄音後失敗，訊息結尾附著一個主機名稱。: Symptom　Submitting a recording fails, and the message ends with a host name.
<b>原因</b> 語音服務只從允許清單上的位址拉錄音檔，而本系統的「錄音檔對外: Cause　The speech service only fetches recordings from addresses on its allow list, and this system's audio base address is not on it.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 把訊息結尾的那個主機名稱交給語音服務的管理員加進允許清單。: What to do　Give the host name at the end of the message to the speech service administrator to add to the allow list. If you change the audio base address, ask them to add the new one too: the same system may be reachable both directly on the internal network and through a reverse proxy, and whichever one you fill in is the one they see.
「對方連不到我們的錄音檔位址」或「網址已經過期」: “Could not reach our recording URL” or “the link had already expired”
<b>症狀</b> 送出錄音後失敗，訊息是「對方連不到我們的錄音檔位址」、\n: Symptom　Submitting a recording fails with “The speech service could not reach our recording URL”, “The link had already expired when the speech service came to fetch the recording”, or “We rejected the speech service when it came to fetch the recording (401 / 403)”.
<b>原因</b> 錄音檔不是本系統推過去的，是<b>對方回頭來拉</b>：本系: Cause　The recording is not pushed to them; they come back and fetch it. This system hands them a short-lived signed URL (/api/speech/audio/…?exp=…&sig=…, no sign-in, expires by itself). If the audio base address is a name only the browser machine can reach (such as localhost), a firewall or reverse proxy is in the way, or the reverse proxy puts a sign-in in front, they cannot fetch it.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 「錄音檔對外位址」要填<b>從語音服務那台連得到</b>的: What to do　Fill in an audio base address that is reachable from the speech service machine (the settings page never derives it from the browser address; guessing wrong would make it work for some people and not others). If the reverse proxy puts SSO, Kerberos or another sign-in in front, let /api/speech/audio/ through; it is already protected by the signature. An expired link usually means it waited or retried too long; submit again.
進度一直不動，或「等了 N 分鐘，對方還沒有回報結果 —— 已經請對方取消」: Progress does not move, or “waited N minutes with no result; asked them to cancel”
<b>症狀</b> 轉逐字稿送出後進度條很久不動；最後失敗並顯示上面那句話。\n: Symptom　After submitting, the progress bar stays still for a long time and the job finally fails with the message above. You may also see “The speech service queue is full. Please submit again later.”
<b>原因</b> 語音服務的 GPU <b>一次只處理一件、其餘排隊</b>。: Cause　The speech service GPU handles one job at a time and queues the rest. While queued and while recognising, the progress they report does not move, so a still progress bar does not by itself mean it is stuck. This system waits for them up to a limit (counted from submission: the larger of 15 minutes and half the recording length); when a very long meeting happens to be ahead in the queue, the limit can pass while still queued, and this system asks them to cancel the job.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 重新送一次；很長的錄音避開別人正在送長會議的時段。\n: What to do　Submit again; for very long recordings, avoid times when someone else is sending a long meeting. If it keeps happening, ask the speech service side to check the queue and the GPU server.
「會議錄音轉逐字稿」是反灰的，或顯示「還沒設定語音服務（jtlw）」: Meeting recording to transcript is greyed out, or says “The speech service is not set up yet”
<b>症狀</b> 側欄與首頁的那支工具點不下去；打開工具頁只看到一句設定提示。: Symptom　The tool cannot be opened from the sidebar or the home page; opening its page only shows a setup notice.
<b>原因</b> 這支工具依賴外部的語音服務，管理區沒有啟用、或送件位址與金鑰: Cause　The tool depends on an external speech service. While it is not enabled in the admin area, or the endpoint and API key are incomplete, it stays greyed out on purpose, so there is never an upload box that looks normal and only fails after you press it.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 到管理區「語音服務（jtlw）」勾選啟用，填好送件位址、A: What to do　In the admin area, open Speech service (jtlw), tick enable, fill in the endpoint, API key and audio base address, press “Test the connection”, then save. The other 49 tools are not affected.
